extraction: ECC create-skill (skill-create command): Generate skills from git history analysis. Agent: build. Analyzes commits for pattern recognition, extracts common practices/conventions, generates structured SKILL.md documentation, creates instincts for continuous-learning-v2. Analysis: git log --oneline -100, commits by file type, most changed files. Patterns: commit message prefixes, naming conventions, co-author patterns, file structure, import organization, error handling, review feedback, recurring fixes, quality gates. Output includes examples, anti-patterns, instincts JSON.
